units.source_text: 朱雀院行幸[\[2\]](#part1336.html#m2)日期，定在十月初十之后。

en.t: The date for the imperial visit to Suzaku-in was set for after the tenth day of the tenth month.

units.source_text: 此次行幸，规模特别盛大，比往常更加有趣。

en.t: This imperial visit was especially grand in scale and even more splendid than usual.

units.source_text: 但舞乐都在外间表演，妃嫔等不能看到，甚是遗憾。

en.t: But since all the music and dancing were performed outside, the consorts and ladies could not see them, which was a great pity.

units.source_text: 皇上为了他所宠爱的藤壶妃子不能看到，总觉美中不足，便命令先在宫中清凉殿试演一番。

en.t: The emperor felt that something was missing because his beloved Lady Fujitsubo could not see the performance, so he ordered it to be rehearsed first in the Seiryoden within the palace.
